card.name: Inside drug and solution names in lists
card.fires_on: Word or name endings inside drug names, IV solution names and body-tissue lists, often in comma or bullet lists of examples. It fires on the last piece of a name, such as 'ate', 'one', 'ot' or 'Injection'.
